parent.name: Pants & Leggings
parent.headline:
Find your fit.
Make your move.
parent.description:
The everyday denim. The easy trouser.
A starting point for wherever the day takes you.
parent.advice: A wider leg changes the silhouette. A higher waist gives a familiar shirt a new shape. Build from a pair you love, add a simple top and choose the finishing layer that feels like you.
parent.detailLine: A rise. A hem. A different feeling.
parent.heroAlt: Campaign inspiration: a woman in taupe wide-leg trousers and an ivory top in a pale stone courtyard
parent.campaignNote: The parent and Corduroy Pants campaign images are illustrative styling inspiration. Other category headers use existing WOW Fashion product photographs.
parent.browseTitle: Find your fit. Make it yours.

collections.name: Black Leggings
collections.headline:
An everyday base.
Your own finish.
collections.description: Simple colour, plenty of possibilities. Discover black leggings to build an easy outfit around.
collections.advice: Try a longer shirt over close-fitting leggings, or a shorter layer with a high waist. Check fabric opacity and the individual measurements before choosing.

collections.name: Bootcut Jeans
collections.headline:
A little flare.
A familiar favourite.
collections.description: A close line through the leg and a wider finish at the hem. Explore bootcut denim with your kind of attitude.
collections.advice: Try bootcut jeans with the shoes you plan to wear and check the inseam. A tucked-in top can bring definition to the waist and balance the flare.

collections.name: Boyfriend Jeans
collections.headline:
Relax the fit.
Keep the feeling.
collections.description: Laid-back denim, distressed details and room to make it personal. Find a relaxed starting point for everyday dressing.
collections.advice: Balance relaxed jeans with a simple tee or a more fitted top. Roll the hem if the length suits, and check the listed rise and hip measurements.
collections.assignment: Editorial selection using the existing product title and relaxed, turned-up shape; no dedicated shop category.

collections.name: Capri Leggings
collections.headline:
Less length.
More possibility.
collections.description: Cropped shapes and easy styling options. Explore capri leggings for your everyday rotation.
collections.advice: A capri hem can sit differently depending on height. Compare the inseam with a pair you own and choose a length that feels comfortable when you move.

collections.name: Cargo / Khaki Pants
collections.headline:
Useful details.
Your kind of style.
collections.description: Cargo pockets, relaxed shapes and a practical-looking edge. Find a pair with plenty of everyday character.
collections.advice: Try cargo trousers with a plain tee or a neat knit. Keep the top simple when the trouser has extra pockets, straps or volume.

collections.name: Casual Pants
collections.headline:
Easy mornings.
Open-ended days.
collections.description: Relaxed silhouettes and pieces that work with what you already wear. Discover casual pants for the plans between the plans.
collections.advice: Pair a loose trouser with a more defined top, or wear a relaxed shirt with a narrower leg. Check the waistband and rise for the fit you prefer.

collections.name: Colored / Patterned Leggings
collections.headline:
Colour outside
the lines.
collections.description: A bold print, a softer shade or a pattern that changes the mood. Find leggings with a little more personality.
collections.advice: Wear patterned leggings with a plain top and simple shoes. Pull one colour from the print into your accessories if you want a more coordinated finish.
collections.assignment: Existing coloured/patterned category, excluding an outfit set whose primary photo does not clearly present leggings.

collections.name: Corduroy Pants
collections.headline:
A little texture.
A warmer mood.
collections.description: Fine ribs, rich colours and a vintage-inspired point of view. A little inspiration for your next corduroy outfit.
collections.advice: A simple knit or crisp shirt lets corduroy texture stand out. Check the wale, fibre blend and garment measurements when choosing the pair that works for you.
collections.note: Our corduroy edit is coming together. No current corduroy products were found in the catalogue; the styles below are other trouser options, not corduroy.
collections.heroAlt: Illustrative campaign styling: caramel corduroy trousers with an ivory knit
collections.assignment: No matching active product in the catalogue or current editorial category. Alternatives are explicitly labelled.

collections.name: Cropped Jeans
collections.headline:
Show a little
ankle.
collections.description: Shorter-looking hems and easy denim shapes. Explore an editorial selection with cropped styling in mind.
collections.advice: Cropped lengths depend on height and fit. Compare the inseam with a pair you own; a turned-up hem can change the look without changing the whole outfit.
collections.assignment: Editorial selection from photographs showing ankle-length or turned-up hems. Length varies by wearer; verify listing inseam.

collections.name: Cropped Pants
collections.headline:
A shorter line.
A fresh perspective.
collections.description: Ankle-skimming shapes and considered details. Find cropped trousers to pair with everyday favourites.
collections.advice: Try a cropped trouser with a simple flat, trainer or boot. Check where the hem sits on you and keep the top proportionate to the leg shape.

collections.name: Denim Shorts
collections.headline:
Denim days.
A lighter version.
collections.description: From a clean waist to a distressed hem. Explore denim shorts for easy warm-weather styling.
collections.advice: Check the waist, hip and inseam measurements together. Pair a fitted short with a relaxed shirt, or keep it simple with a tucked-in tee.

collections.name: Flared Pants
collections.headline:
A little movement.
A different rhythm.
collections.description: A defined line that opens at the hem. Discover flared trousers, from subtle shape to expressive print.
collections.advice: Try a fitted or tucked-in top to keep the waist visible. Check the trouser length with your chosen shoes so the hem sits where you want it.

collections.name: Fleece Lined / Thermal Leggings
collections.headline:
Layer up.
Stay yourself.
collections.description: Lined styles and cooler-day possibilities. Explore the thermal legging edit for your next layered outfit.
collections.advice: Read the listing for lining, fibre composition and thickness. Warmth depends on the garment and conditions; leave room for comfortable movement beneath longer layers.

collections.name: Harem Pants
collections.headline:
Room to move.
Room to be you.
collections.description: Relaxed volume, tapered finishes and expressive shapes. Explore harem trousers with an easy point of view.
collections.advice: A simple close-fitting top can balance a fuller trouser. Check the rise and leg shape in the photographs, and compare the measurements with a comfortable pair you own.

collections.name: High Waisted Jeans
collections.headline:
A higher rise.
A fresh start.
collections.description: Defined waists and denim shapes with everyday possibility. Find high-waisted jeans to make your own.
collections.advice: Try a tucked-in shirt or a shorter knit to show the rise. Check the waist and hip measurements together, particularly when switching between fitted and relaxed cuts.

collections.name: High Waisted Leggings
collections.headline:
A higher waist.
An easy base.
collections.description: Clean-looking lines, considered waistbands and plenty of styling options. Explore the high-waisted legging edit.
collections.advice: Compare the rise and waistband measurements with a pair you like. Check opacity and fabric details, then add a relaxed shirt or simple top.

collections.name: High Waisted Pants
collections.headline:
Define the waist.
Set the mood.
collections.description: From a wider leg to a closer silhouette. Find high-waisted trousers that bring an outfit together.
collections.advice: A tucked-in top helps show the waistline; a cropped jacket can do the same. Check the rise so the waistband sits where you find it comfortable.

collections.name: Leather Pants
collections.headline:
A sharper line.
A softer balance.
collections.description: Leather-look finishes, clean shapes and a little edge. Discover trousers that make a simple outfit feel different.
collections.advice: Try a leather-look trouser with a soft knit or plain cotton shirt. The shop category includes faux and PU finishes: check each listing for exact composition and care.

collections.name: Linen Pants
collections.headline:
An easy drape.
A lighter day.
collections.description: Relaxed shapes and an unhurried feeling from the linen trouser edit. Find a pair to start a softer outfit.
collections.advice: Pair a flowing trouser with a simple tank or a loosely tucked shirt. Check the specific fibre blend, opacity and care instructions on the product listing.

collections.name: Ripped Jeans
collections.headline:
A familiar blue.
A little character.
collections.description: Distressed finishes and everyday denim shapes. Explore ripped jeans with your kind of detail.
collections.advice: Let the distressed areas be the detail and choose a plain top or clean jacket. Check the product photos to see the placement and extent of the openings.

collections.name: Short Pants
collections.headline:
A shorter shape.
A playful mood.
collections.description: Easy hems and expressive detail from the short pants edit. A starting point for a lighter outfit.
collections.advice: Try a relaxed shirt over a shorter bottom or tuck in a simple top to show the waist. Check both the rise and inseam to choose your preferred coverage.

collections.name: Skinny Jeans
collections.headline:
A closer fit.
A familiar feeling.
collections.description: Slim denim shapes with plenty of styling possibilities. Find skinny jeans for your everyday wardrobe.
collections.advice: Check the fabric blend and garment measurements before choosing a size. A longer shirt or relaxed knit can balance the close-fitting leg.

collections.name: Skinny Pants
collections.headline:
A clean line.
A little definition.
collections.description: Close-fitting shapes and considered details. Explore skinny trousers to balance your favourite looser layers.
collections.advice: Try a slim trouser with an oversized shirt or relaxed jacket. Check the waist, hip and stretch details rather than relying on the style name alone.

collections.name: Velvet Leggings
collections.headline:
A softer finish.
A richer feeling.
collections.description: Textured-looking styles and a little depth of colour. Explore the velvet legging edit for your next outfit.
collections.advice: Pair a velvet-look finish with a plain knit or smooth shirt. Check the listing for the exact fabric, lining and care guidance before choosing.

collections.name: Wide Leg Trousers
collections.headline:
Take a little
space.
collections.description: Flowing lines, relaxed shapes and room to move. Find wide-leg trousers that set the tone for your outfit.
collections.style: Define one part of the shape
collections.advice: Try a tucked-in top or a shorter jacket to show the waist. Check the inseam with your intended shoes so the longer line falls comfortably.

collections.name: Work Pants
collections.headline:
Ready for
your day.
collections.description: A considered starting point for the working wardrobe. Explore the shop’s work trouser edit and style it your way.
collections.advice: Check your workplace dress expectations, then balance a patterned trouser with a plain blouse or knit. Compare the rise and length with a pair you already wear.

collections.name: Jeans
collections.headline:
Your everyday
denim story.
collections.description: Relaxed cuts, expressive details and a familiar foundation. Explore the jeans edit and find a shape to make your own.
collections.advice: Start with the leg shape and rise you enjoy wearing. Then compare measurements and fabric details, leaving wash and finishing touches to make it personal.

collections.name: Joggers
collections.headline:
Slow down.
Step out.
collections.description: Relaxed-looking lines and an off-duty point of view. Discover the jogger edit for easy everyday dressing.
collections.advice: Pair joggers with a plain tee and an easy jacket. Check the waistband, cuffs and fabric details to choose the fit and feel you prefer.

collections.name: Shorts
collections.headline:
A lighter layer.
A longer day.
collections.description: From relaxed shapes to denim and coordinated sets. Find shorts for the warm-weather side of your wardrobe.
collections.advice: Check the inseam and rise together to find comfortable coverage. Balance a loose short with a simpler top, or layer an open shirt over the outfit.
collections.assignment: Existing shorts category, excluding a shirt-focused set photo.
